summary: Hotz is enthusiastic about practical AI, doubts runaway superintelligence and argues that ordinary people should own AI, not rely on a few companies.

statements.quote: I love the progress. I’m so excited for the new LLMs, self driving cars, video generation models, and coding agents.
statements.venue: Blog post, I love LLMs, I hate hype

statements.quote: Intelligence is not the end all be all, it’s just the current bottleneck for a few things. You cannot take over the world with tokens.
statements.venue: Blog post, AI 2040 and the Cult of Intelligence

statements.quote: AI will be cheap, everywhere, collapse a bunch of sectors of work, wreck wage premiums, and cause a big reevaluation of status hierarchies.
statements.venue: Blog post, AI will be massively deflationary

statements.quote: I’m not sure it’s possible, but if there is a bad scenario with AI, it’s a singleton with nothing that can substantially impact reality outside of it.
statements.venue: Blog post, There is only one bad AI scenario

statements.quote: The good world is where everyone has AI, and not as a revokable privilege through an API, but through hard possession.
statements.venue: Blog post, Do you really want the US to “win” AI?
